item.title: Vanderhall Recalls Brawley GTS Electric Recreational Off Highway Vehicles (ROVs) Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Crash Hazard
item.company: Vanderhall North America, LLC, of Provo, Utah
item.brand: Vanderhall North America, LLC, of Provo, Utah
item.product: Model Year 2024-2026 Vanderhall Brawley GTS electric recreational off highway vehicles
item.summary: This recall involves all Vanderhall model years 2024, 2025, and 2026 Brawley GTS electric recreational off highway vehicles. The ROVs come in Emerald Green, Ida Rose, Ivory White, Jean Grey, Obsidian Black, and Royal Blue. The VIN Numbers for the affected vehicles range from XXXXXXXXXXXXX5927 - XXXXXXXXXXXXX 6152 and can be found under the dashboard on the driver’s side of the vehicle.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Model Year 2024-2026 Vanderhall Brawley GTS electric recreational off highway vehicles.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using their vehicles immediately and contact Vanderhall North America for instructions on how to receive updated firmware version 8.1.2 through the Vanderhall customer mobile app. The updated firmware was released on September 18, 2026, and can be identified by the Vanderhall logo. Owners requiring assistance updating their firmware should contact their dealer or Vanderhall directly for assistance.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
